# Enterprise Support & Community Policy

## 1. Support Channels

Welcome to `afshin-omnisystem/Oship`. To ensure fast, deterministic assistance, please route your inquiries through the appropriate enterprise communication channel:

| Channel | Purpose | Expected Response |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/afshin-omnisystem/Oship/discussions) | Architectural questions, ideas, announcements, and general Q&A. | 1–2 Business Days |
| [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/afshin-omnisystem/Oship/issues) | Verified bug reports, feature proposals, and actionable engineering tasks. | According to Issue SLA |
| [Security Advisories](https://github.com/afshin-omnisystem/Oship/security/advisories) | Private reporting of security vulnerabilities and risks. | 24 Hours SLA |

## 2. Issue Triage & SLA Matrix

Every issue opened via standard GitHub Issue Forms is automatically categorized by label and prioritized:

- **`priority: critical`**: Immediate triage (within 4 hours); blocks releases or security.
- **`priority: high`**: Triage within 24 hours; scheduled for immediate milestone sprint.
- **`priority: medium`**: Triage within 48 hours; scheduled in normal roadmap cadence.
- **`priority: low`**: Triage within 5 business days; evaluated for backlog or community help.

## 3. Self-Service Documentation

Before opening a support inquiry, consult our enterprise documentation hierarchy:
